title: Exporting Sales Rep Assignments downloads sales-rep-assignments.csv with the verbatim headers and shows the success toast
custom_preconds:
1. At least one customer in the organization has an assigned sales rep.
2. The Export Report dialog is open with "Sales Rep Assignments" selected.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Export action.
2. Note the saved file's name and read the toast.
3. Open the file in a text editor and read the header row.
custom_expected:
1. The file downloads as "sales-rep-assignments.csv".
2. A success toast shows "Success" with the caption "Report downloaded." and auto-fades after 5 seconds.
3. The CSV starts with a UTF-8 BOM and its headers, in order, are exactly: Customer Name, Sales Rep, Rep is active?.
